system: You are a security investigator reviewing an alert. Base every claim only on the evidence available to you. Cite the record IDs that support each observation.

supporting_observations.claim: The account ext.rwong was created at 13:44:07 UTC by nora.blake, later than the alert's approximate 13:42 time.
The same nora.blake logon session that created the account added it to the Freelancers group.
The account name and its observed addition to Freelancers are consistent with the stated help-desk process for temporary accounts.
A network logon for nora.blake from WS-NBLAKE-01 occurred shortly before the account was created, and its logon ID matches the subject logon ID in the account-creation and group-addition events.
Cisco AnyConnect's VPN UI was launched under nora.blake's session after the account was created; the loaded VPN API DLL is recorded as validly signed by Cisco.
The available records establish a VPN client launch, but do not establish that a VPN connection was made.
A proxy record shows Chrome traffic to Bing before the stated proxy collection outage; it does not describe activity during the outage window.

known_telemetry_limitations: Proxy collection on the proxy host was unavailable from 13:30 to 14:10 UTC due to a log collection outage, overlapping most of the review window.
The supplied records do not include any Zeek connection, DNS, or SSL events, despite those sensors being reported as operational.
claims_not_established: Whether ext.rwong was approved or requested as a temporary account.
Whether the account received any group memberships or privileges beyond the Freelancers addition shown in the supplied records.
Whether AnyConnect established a VPN connection or was used for remote access.
Whether activity during the proxy collection outage involved unapproved services, data transfer, or other malicious behavior.
Whether the account was subsequently used.
additional_evidence_needed: The account request, approval, and help-desk ticket associated with ext.rwong.
Directory audit and current account-membership details for ext.rwong, including any privilege changes or subsequent use.
AnyConnect connection/session logs and configuration from WS-NBLAKE-01 to determine whether a VPN connection was established.
Proxy records for 13:30–14:10 UTC, if recoverable, and relevant endpoint or network-flow evidence for that interval.
